description: Local Government Engineering Department Bangladesh is a data repository run by Local Government Engineering Department (LGED), Bangladesh. LGED maintains the rural and urban road, bridge, culvert, growth-centre and small-scale water resource inventories of Bangladesh and publishes road-network databases and maps. Coverage: Bangladesh. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as html, pdf, shp; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account.
